criteria.name: Design

evidence.quote: PantryPal turns a photo of your fridge into three recipes you can cook tonight
you upload a photo and PantryPal lists what it sees

criteria.verdict: A complete loop from photo to dinner, with a confirm step.
criteria.fix: What happens when the model misreads the photo: can the user fix a single ingredient by hand?

criteria.name: Potential Impact

evidence.quote: Students who move into their first apartment waste about a third of the food they buy, and PantryPal turns a photo of your fridge
reducing household food waste by 31% in a three-week pilot

criteria.verdict: A specific audience and a tested claim, but the sample is small.
criteria.fix: What did the three students who didn't cook more need from the photo step?

criteria.name: Innovation/Idea

evidence.quote: a novel graph-based ingredient matching algorithm
unlike every existing recipe app, ours runs entirely on-device

criteria.verdict: Claims novelty in the matching algorithm.
criteria.fix: Name one existing recipe app and say what PantryPal does that it does not.

criteria.name: Presentation
criteria.verdict: Nothing in your text shows the project working end to end.
criteria.fix: Which moment in your video shows a recipe going from photo to cooked dinner, and where do you say who it is for?
